title: CALPHAD method
description: Documented public alloy thermodynamics method (Kaufman (method); Thermo-Calc) for the Alloy Discovery Engine capability area.
body:
CALPHAD method is a documented alloy thermodynamics method from Kaufman (method); Thermo-Calc. Calculation of phase diagrams from assessed thermodynamic data — the standard computational method for designing alloy compositions since the 1970s.

How it works: It works by applying the linear rule of mixtures: the composite property is the fraction-weighted sum of the component properties.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
